title: GraphQL Federation Architecture
description: A GraphQL federation architecture diagram with an Apollo Gateway building query plans and fanning out to User, Product, and Review subgraphs, each owning its schema and database, with response stitching into a unified GraphQL result. This template models the federated GraphQL approach where multiple teams independently develop and deploy their subgraphs while clients see a single unified API. Ideal for organizations scaling GraphQL across multiple teams and services.
